description: Default zero-shot entity and relation schema for building a user-level PII graph from email-style corpora. Uses GLiNER for entities and GLiREL for relations.

entity_labels.PERSON: A human individual, including first names, full names, and pronouns resolved to a person.
entity_labels.PHONE_NUMBER: A telephone, mobile, office, or fax number.
entity_labels.AGE: A number expressing a person's age in years, often following words like 'aged' or 'years old'.
entity_labels.DATE: A calendar date, time period, or temporal expression such as a date of birth.
entity_labels.CITY: A city, town, or populated place name.
entity_labels.COUNTRY: A country, nation, or sovereign state.
entity_labels.ORGANIZATION: A company, institution, agency, employer, or other organized group.
entity_labels.JOB_TITLE: A job title, role, or position such as 'CEO' or 'engineer'.
entity_labels.HOME_ADDRESS: A postal or street address where a person lives or works.
entity_labels.NAME: The canonical full name of a person, used as an identity signal when email addresses are unavailable.

has_email_address.description: The person uses or owns the email address.

has_phone_number.description: The person uses or owns the phone number.

lives_in_city.description: The person lives in the city.

lives_in_country.description: The person lives in the country.

country_of_origin.description: The person's country of origin or nationality.

works_at_organization.description: The person is employed by or works at the organization.

has_job_title.description: The person's job title or role.

has_home_address.description: The person's home or work address.

notes: This schema is intentionally conservative: heads are always PERSON so every extracted fact is attributed to a user.
Add custom relations by creating a new JSON file with the same structure, e.g. {'has_car': {'allowed_head': ['PERSON'], 'allowed_tail': ['VEHICLE']}}.
GLiNER zero-shot labels can be passed as plain strings or as a {label: description} dict. Descriptions usually improve accuracy for rare labels.
